collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A small child is terrified of the festival dancers' masks: meet a dancer up close, or watch from further back.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It's festival night, and the dancers have put on their big carved masks: huge eyes, enormous painted mouths, feathers everywhere. Everyone is cheering. (subject) is hiding behind (friend)'s legs, holding on very tightly, absolutely terrified.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) waves one of the dancers over. The dancer kneels down, slowly lifts off the mask, and underneath is (dancer), a perfectly ordinary, smiling villager (subject) knows. "It's just me," (dancer) says. (subject) stares. Then (subject.he/she) touches the mask very carefully. (subject.He/she) is still a bit scared of the masks. Less of (dancer).

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) picks (subject) up and moves to the very back, near the trees, where the masks are small and far away. From here, the dancing is beautiful. (subject) watches with (subject.his/her) face half hidden in (friend)'s shoulder, peeking. By the end of the night, (subject.he/she) is peeking with both eyes.
